newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lufthansa to add Shanghai-FRA cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to add Shanghai-FRA cargo capacity.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo is awaiting last minute approval to add another 30 tonnes of air cargo capacity between Shanghai and Frankfurt with a second weekly non-stop 747-400 Combi service, Lufthansa Cargo's managing director for China, Hong Kong and Taiwan, Christian Sedelmaier, has told Reuters.

The additional Sunday service is due to begin on March 30 but still awaits confirmation by both the Chinese and German governments. Sedelmaier said approval is usually confirmed just before start-up and expects no problems.

"We are continuing to develop in China by separating the Shanghai and Beijing markets so they are served independently and this flight will give us another 30 tonnes cargo capacity. We expect the new flight to be confirmed very soon," Sedelmaier added.

The extra non-stop will mean Lufthansa offers a total of three weekly flights from Shanghai and six from Beijing. More cargo capacity is available on another six weekly passenger and freighter flights operated by code-share partner Air China, Sedelmaier added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
